final: WITH circuit_race_counts AS (SELECT c.circuitId, c.country, COUNT(*) as circuit_race_count FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId WHERE r.date > '1978-03-04' AND r.date < '2003-03-09' GROUP BY c.circuitId, c.country), country_averages AS (SELECT country, AVG(circuit_race_count) as country_avg FROM circuit_race_counts GROUP BY country) SELECT crc.circuitId, crc.country, crc.circuit_race_count, CAST(crc.circuit_race_count AS REAL) / ca.country_avg as ratio FROM circuit_race_counts crc LEFT JOIN country_averages ca ON crc.country = ca.country ORDER BY ratio IS NULL, ratio DESC LIMIT 10
